build_note: Listed 6-5, 220 lb (RealGM), 6-11 wingspan in 2009 pre-draft measurements (SLAM)
story: New York erased a 10-point fourth-quarter lead. Harden's pull-up broke a 101–101 tie, and Cleveland won 115–107.
aria: Original illustration of James Harden's pull-up 3-pointer with 4 minutes 22 seconds left in the fourth quarter that broke a 101–101 tie at Madison Square Garden. Not traced from footage, not to scale.
